# Copyright 2025 Intel Corporation.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# ARM64-native NEON and crypto (AES) tests. These are self-contained
# aarch64-only tests using <arm_neon.h>; they are skipped (no-op) on x86-64
# because the entire subdir is entered only under the aarch64 guard below.
# (The x86-64 counterpart of crypto coverage is the OpenSSL SHA test under
# tests/cpu/openssl, gated separately by ssl_link_type.)

if host_machine.cpu_family() == 'aarch64'
    # crypto_test.cpp uses vaeseq_u8 / vaesmcq_u8, which require the +crypto
    # target; neon_test.cpp uses baseline armv8.1-A NEON. A single march covers
    # both files.
    arm64_cpp_flags = [
        '-march=armv8.1-a+crc+crypto',
    ]

    arm64_tests = files(
        'neon_test.cpp',
        'crypto_test.cpp',
        # di/dt voltage-transient power virus ("版图三 瞬态故障动态激发").
        # Alternates NEON full-load bursts with yield stalls to induce voltage
        # droop and excite transient SDC on the SIMD/FMA path — the only
        # burst/stall power-virus in the suite. Built only on aarch64.
        'power_virus_dit.cpp',
        'sdc_test.cpp',
        # Integer Execution Unit SDC stress — coverage-weak unit (IEX 70%).
        # Full IEX opcode combination (add/sub/and/or/xor/mul/shift/clz/rbit/
        # rev) over high-Hamming operands with serial dependency, plus
        # carry-flag dependent adcs/sbcs/csel chains run twice to detect
        # non-deterministic flag-rename SDC — the opcode-mix and flag-rename
        # surfaces operand_space_arm/adcx/mrn_ never cover. Built only on
        # aarch64.
        'iex_operand_combo_arm.cpp',
        # Instruction-Fetch Unit SDC stress — coverage-weak unit (IFU 66%).
        # JIT-generated data-dependent indirect-branch (br) dispatch table
        # with a high-Hamming target permutation and padded blocks, to
        # torture the branch predictor / BTB / instruction-cache path that no
        # existing test targets. Built only on aarch64.
        'ifu_branch_target_arm.cpp',
        # Out-of-order execution SDC stress — coverage-weak unit (OoO 56%).
        # Pointer-chasing dependency chain, carry-dependent mixed ALU+memory
        # chain, RW-hazard interleave, and long dependent ALU chains to stress
        # the scheduler/ROB/rename under serial dependencies — the replay/
        # rename surface no existing test targets. Built only on aarch64.
        'ooo_dep_chain_arm.cpp',
        # LSU store-buffer/load-forwarding SDC stress — coverage-weak unit
        # (LSU 54%). Same-size forward at widths 1/2/4/8/16B and offsets
        # including the cache-line boundary, partial-store forwarding/merging,
        # store-after-load hazard, 128B cross-line forward, and strided
        # same-line forward — the forwarding datapath no existing memory test
        # targets. Built only on aarch64.
        'lsu_store_forward_arm.cpp',
        # L2 cache coherency/split-access SDC stress — coverage-weak unit
        # (L2C 40%). Adds cross-64B-line exclusive ldxr/stxr RMW, store-to-load
        # forwarding across the line boundary, dc-civac writeback probe, and a
        # 2x-L2 thrash sweep — the coherency/snoop/split surfaces that
        # memcpy_l2_cache_size never touches. Built only on aarch64.
        'l2c_cross_cache_line_arm.cpp',
        # MMU/TLB/PTW SDC stress — the coverage-weakest unit (MMU 20%). Adds
        # page-color aliasing (one physical page, many VAs), dual-TLB-lookup
        # cross-page and cross-cache-line split accesses, and a large-ASID
        # pressure sweep, none of which mmu_stress_arm exercises. Built only
        # on aarch64.
        'mmu_split_tlb_arm.cpp',
        # Floating-point/SIMD Unit byte-exact SDC stress (FSU 80% — highest
        # weak unit, but with a real gap: fma.cpp compares with a 1e-6
        # tolerance, so a 1-bit FSU SDC passes. This test is byte-exact
        # throughout: FMA over the full IEEE-754 special-value table, cross-
        # cache-line 128B NEON data path, single<->double widen/narrow, and
        # a high-Hamming dependent FMA chain, all compared bit-exact against
        # libm. Built only on aarch64.
        'fsu_byteexact_arm.cpp',
        # AGU throughput stress: 2 source loads + data-ALU + store/reload/
        # store chain (3 ldr + 2 str per element), maximizing address-
        # generation pressure. Rotation uses {add,eor,and,orr} — a different
        # composition than mrn_nuke_2src_alu's {add,sub,eor,and} — to test
        # rotation-composition robustness of the core-179 trigger recipe.
        # Dual-arch inline asm (x86 movq / aarch64 str-ldr), placed in the
        # ARM64 suite per the arm64 classification. Built only on aarch64.
        'agu_stress_2src.cpp',
        # NEON/vector-datapath port of the core-179 trigger recipe: 2 source
        # vector loads + rotating vector ALU {add,eor,and,orr} (uint64x2) +
        # back-to-back vector store/reload/store. The asm-guaranteed str q ->
        # ldr q pair (the compiler eliminates the intrinsic reload) makes it
        # discriminate whether the trigger recipe is bound to the scalar
        # ALU/L1D path or also fires on the SIMD datapath. Uses uint64x2_t
        # unconditionally, so it can only be built on aarch64.
        'neon_rot_2src.cpp',
    )

    arm64_tests_lib = static_library(
        'tests_arm64',
        arm64_tests,
        build_by_default: false,
        include_directories: [
            framework_incdir,
        ],
        dependencies: [
            boost_dep,
        ],
        cpp_args: [
            debug_c_flags,
            default_cpp_warn,
            default_cpp_flags,
            march_generic_flags,
            arm64_cpp_flags,
        ],
    )

    # SVE full-vector-length gather/scatter SDC stress. Compiled in its own
    # static library because <arm_sve.h> intrinsics require the +sve target,
    # while the tests_arm64 baseline stays armv8.1-a+crc+crypto: enabling
    # +sve for the whole library could let GCC auto-vectorize the NEON tests
    # into SVE instructions, which would SIGILL on SVE-less CPUs such as
    # this Kunpeng 920. The test probes HWCAP_SVE first thing in test_init
    # and returns a clean EXIT_SKIP on SVE-less CPUs, so its SVE codegen
    # only ever executes on SVE-capable hardware. Built only on aarch64.
    arm64_sve_lib = static_library(
        'tests_arm64_sve',
        files(
            'sve512_gather_scatter_arm.cpp',
        ),
        build_by_default: false,
        include_directories: [
            framework_incdir,
        ],
        dependencies: [
            boost_dep,
        ],
        cpp_args: [
            debug_c_flags,
            default_cpp_warn,
            default_cpp_flags,
            march_generic_flags,
            '-march=armv8.2-a+sve',
        ],
    )

    sandstone_tests += [
        arm64_tests_lib,
        arm64_sve_lib,
    ]
endif

1	# 集成 sve512_gather_scatter_arm 到 arm64 测试分类
2	
3	日期：2026-09-14
4	
5	## 背景
6	
7	用户提供了一个新的 SVE gather/scather SDC 测试源文件（从 sve512_fma 研究
8	中单独提取的 workload 4）：
9	
10	- `sve512_gather_scatter_arm.cpp` — SVE 全向量长度 gather/scatter 压力：
11	  `svld1_gather_u64index_f64`（按元素索引从置换索引表 gather）+
12	  `svmla_f64_x`（v = 1.5 + v*v）+ `svst1_scatter_u64index_f64`（按同一
13	  索引 scatter 回暂存区），与走同一间接索引的标量 golden 逐字节比较。
14	- 本机（Kunpeng 920）**无 SVE**（/proc/cpuinfo 实测无 sve 特性），用户
15	  要求编译通过即可，不要求本机跑通（test_init 入口即探测 HWCAP_SVE，
16	  无 SVE 时干净 EXIT_SKIP）。
17	
18	## 决策
19	
20	- 文件放入 `tests/cpu/arm64/`（整个子目录仅在 aarch64 构建，x86-64 不受
21	  影响）。
22	- **不并入 `tests_arm64` 库**：该库基线 `-march=armv8.1-a+crc+crypto` 不含
23	  +sve，`<arm_sve.h>` 内联函数无法编译；且不能给整个库加 +sve——GCC 会把
24	  其他 NEON 测试自动向量化成 SVE 指令，无 SVE 机器上 SIGILL。
25	- 在 `tests/cpu/arm64/meson.build` 新建独立静态库 `tests_arm64_sve`，
26	  `-march=armv8.2-a+sve`（与 tests/cpu/meson.build 已有 SVE 构建块相同的
27	  march 组合），仅含本文件。用户代码原样，零修改。
28	- 运行时安全：test_init 第一行即探测 HWCAP_SVE，失败即 return EXIT_SKIP，

# 集成 sve512_gather_scatter_arm 到 arm64 测试分类

日期：2026-09-14

## 背景

用户提供了一个新的 SVE gather/scather SDC 测试源文件（从 sve512_fma 研究
中单独提取的 workload 4）：

- `sve512_gather_scatter_arm.cpp` — SVE 全向量长度 gather/scatter 压力：
  `svld1_gather_u64index_f64`（按元素索引从置换索引表 gather）+
  `svmla_f64_x`（v = 1.5 + v*v）+ `svst1_scatter_u64index_f64`（按同一
  索引 scatter 回暂存区），与走同一间接索引的标量 golden 逐字节比较。
- 本机（Kunpeng 920）**无 SVE**（/proc/cpuinfo 实测无 sve 特性），用户
  要求编译通过即可，不要求本机跑通（test_init 入口即探测 HWCAP_SVE，
  无 SVE 时干净 EXIT_SKIP）。

## 决策

- 文件放入 `tests/cpu/arm64/`（整个子目录仅在 aarch64 构建，x86-64 不受
  影响）。
- **不并入 `tests_arm64` 库**：该库基线 `-march=armv8.1-a+crc+crypto` 不含
  +sve，`<arm_sve.h>` 内联函数无法编译；且不能给整个库加 +sve——GCC 会把
  其他 NEON 测试自动向量化成 SVE 指令，无 SVE 机器上 SIGILL。
- 在 `tests/cpu/arm64/meson.build` 新建独立静态库 `tests_arm64_sve`，
  `-march=armv8.2-a+sve`（与 tests/cpu/meson.build 已有 SVE 构建块相同的
  march 组合），仅含本文件。用户代码原样，零修改。
- 运行时安全：test_init 第一行即探测 HWCAP_SVE，失败即 return EXIT_SKIP，
  无 SVE 机器上不执行任何 SVE 指令。
- README.md 同步：用例总数以 `--list-tests` 实测数为准更新，ARM64 SDC
  专项表补该测试。

## One-patch-per-unit 分解

单个 unit（一个 commit）。

### Task 1: 集成 sve512_gather_scatter_arm

文件变更：
- 新建 `tests/cpu/arm64/sve512_gather_scatter_arm.cpp`（用户代码原样）
- `tests/cpu/arm64/meson.build`：新增 `tests_arm64_sve` 静态库块
- `README.md`：用例计数 + ARM64 SDC 专项表
- 本计划文件

验证（真实命令，引用真实输出）：
1. `ninja -C builddir` — 零新增 error/warning
2. `./builddir/sdcshield --list-tests | grep sve512_gather_scatter_arm` — 已注册
3. `./builddir/sdcshield -e sve512_gather_scatter_arm -t 1000` — 本机无 SVE，
   预期干净 skip（证明 HWCAP 守卫生效、无 SVE 指令泄漏到 skip 路径）
4. 回归：`./builddir/sdcshield -e zstd19 -t 3000` — `exit: pass`
5. x86-64 非回归：全部变更在 aarch64 guard 内（meson 检查确认）

- [ ] Task 1 完成

# ARM64 suite per the arm64 classification. Built only on aarch64.
        'agu_stress_2src.cpp',
        # NEON/vector-datapath port of the core-179 trigger recipe: 2 source
        # vector loads + rotating vector ALU {add,eor,and,orr} (uint64x2) +
        # back-to-back vector store/reload/store. The asm-guaranteed str q ->
        # ldr q pair (the compiler eliminates the intrinsic reload) makes it
        # discriminate whether the trigger recipe is bound to the scalar
        # ALU/L1D path or also fires on the SIMD datapath. Uses uint64x2_t
        # unconditionally, so it can only be built on aarch64.
        'neon_rot_2src.cpp',
        # movbe byte-swap SDC series (moved from tests/cpu/misc): the core-179
        # research testbed of the byte-swap round-trip trigger. movbe is the
        # baseline (bswap + store + bswap-back + compare), movbe_dump adds the
        # full dump on failure, and the 11 movbe_dump_probe_* variants remove
        # or vary one ingredient at a time (no-store, reload position, ...)
        # to localize the trigger. All portable __builtin_bswap32 (no arch
        # guards), classified ARM64-only with the rest of the core-179 probes.
        'movbe.cpp',
        'movbe_dump.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_a.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_b.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_c.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_d.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_e.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_f.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_g1.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_g2.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_h.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_x.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_xn.cpp',
        # Scan-order variant of neon_rot_ldr_at_top (core-179 attribution):
        # even outer iterations sweep indices ascending, odd descending, so
        # the touch pattern at the corruption-concentrated first indices
        # (idx 0/1 of the 55-record dump campaign) differs from the parent's
        # fixed order. Strong idx-0/1 signal here too -> the signature
        # follows the buffer slots (address-local, e.g. same L1D set/way);
        # signature moves to the sweep seam / disappears -> it follows the
        # forward-progress position. Same 3rd-ldr-at-top + 2-src loads +
        # rotating vector ALU {add,eor,and,orr} + back-to-back str/str
        # skeleton otherwise. uint64x2_t / aarch64 inline asm only — built
        # only on aarch64.
        'neon_rot_ldr_at_top_rowmajor.cpp',
    )

    arm64_tests_lib = static_library(
        'tests_arm64',
        arm64_tests,
        build_by_default: false,
        include_directories: [
            framework_incdir,
        ],
        dependencies: [
            boost_dep,
        ],
        cpp_args: [
            debug_c_flags,
            default_cpp_warn,
            default_cpp_flags,
            march_generic_flags,
            arm64_cpp_flags,
        ],
    )

    sandstone_tests += [
        arm64_tests_lib,
    ]

content.thinking:
Now I understand the mechanism: the skip message "test compiled with sve" comes from the framework's `run_one_test_once` at framework/sandstone_run.cpp:1558. The `compiler_minimum_device` is populated by the framework based on what the compilation unit was compiled with (via `#pragma GCC target` or the `-march` flags — there's a mechanism that detects `__ARM_FEATURE_SVE` etc. per test). Since this test was compiled with `-march=armv8.2-a+sve`, the framework records SVE in `compiler_minimum_device`, and at runtime, since the Kunpeng 920 lacks SVE, the framework skips before even forking — cleaner than the test's own HWCAP check (which is a second layer of defense).

So the skip is legitimate and framework-driven: `test compiled with sve` — the framework detected the TU was compiled with SVE and the CPU doesn't have it. This is exactly the same mechanism as `eigen_svd_cdouble_sve` (which README says "Kunpeng 920 在 init 阶段干净跳过"). Actually let me verify how compiler_minimum_device gets set... it's likely from `sandstone.h` detecting `__ARM_FEATURE_SVE` at compile time. That's fine — the important thing is the skip is real, framework-level, category CpuNotSupported, and no SVE instruction executed.

Both layers work: framework skips first (before fork even), and the test's own HWCAP guard would catch it if the framework didn't.

Now regression: zstd19. Then update README + plan, commit, push.

content.text:
已定位 skip 来源：`framework/sandstone_run.cpp:1558` —— 框架在运行前检测到该编译单元以 `+sve` 编译（`compiler_minimum_device` 含 SVE）而本机无 SVE，在 fork 之前就跳过（`CpuNotSupported`）。这是框架级守卫，比测试自身的 HWCAP 探测更早生效，双层守卫都在。机制合法，skip 真实。

继续回归验证：

148	## 测试用例与检测能力
149	
150	当前 ARM64 构建（Kunpeng 920 / openEuler 24.03 SP3）共 **273 个用例**：PROD 264、BETA 4、SKIP 5。许多用例沿用上游 x86 名字（如 `mesh_upi_avx2_*`、`ipsec_*_avx`、`fma_*_avx512`），但实现已落到 NEON / ARM 原生指令，命名保留是为与 x86 参考用例跨架构比对。
151	
152	| 检测域 | 代表用例 | 检测能力 |
153	|---|---|---|
154	| 内存 / 拷贝 | `memcpy_l{1d,2,3}_cache_size`、`memcpy_rewr`、`mem_disambiguation`、`mmu_stress_arm` | 各级缓存带宽、store-to-load 转发、跨行一致性与内存序、TLB 扰动 |
155	| 缓存 / 互联 | `cachebounce`、`mesh_upi_*`（27） | cache line 弹跳、CLFLUSH 压力、MESH/UPI 多核读写协同 |
156	| 锁 / 原子 | `lock*`、`lockless_cmpxchg*`、`atomic_simd_*`、`spinlock_*`（32） | 锁指令、无锁 cmpxchg、128/256/512 位原子、自旋锁各类竞争（ARM64 atomic） |
157	| 向量 / SIMD | `swizzle`、`insert_extract`、`kreg1`–`kreg9`、`gather*` | NEON 排列/插入抽取、掩码寄存器（x86 k-reg 仿真）、gather/scatter |
158	| FMA / 浮点 | `fma`、`fma_patterns_*`、`fma_tail*`、`fpu_special_values` | FMA 模式与尾数精度穷举、特殊值逐字节 golden 比对 |
159	| 算术 / 大整数 | `adcx`、`adox`、`adcxlong`、`adcx_arm`、`bigint_mulx_arm`、`gmp_big*` | 进位/溢出链、GMP 大整数乘加、高汉明距离操作数压满加法器 |
160	| CRC / 校验 | `crc32`、`isal_crc{32,64}_*`、`zpclmul*` | `crc32` 指令、isa-l CRC32/CRC64 各标准、zlib PCLMUL 折叠 |
161	| 压缩 | `zlib*`、`zstd*`、`zfuzz` | zlib/zstd 压缩-解压往返、各级别、fuzz |
162	| 线性代数（Eigen） | `eigen_gemm_*`、`eigen_sparse`、`eigen_svd*`（含 `_cdouble_sve`） | GEMM、稀疏 Cholesky、SVD（BDCSVD/Jacobi）施压 FMA/向量 |
163	| IPSec / 密码 | `ipsec_*`（46） | AES-CBC/CTR/GCM、HMAC-SHA1/2、XCBC/CMAC/3DES-DOCSIS 于 NEON |
164	| OpenSSL SHA | `openssl_sha` | SHA-256/384/512 vs golden（需 `ssl_link_type≠none`） |
165	| ARM 加密扩展 | `arm_crypto` | AES（AESE/AESMC）crypto 数据通路 |
166	| 虚拟化 / 系统寄存器 | `vmx_vmexit_*`、`vmxmsr` | guest 触发 vmexit 退出路径一致性 |
167	| ARM64 SDC 专项 | `arm64_sdc`、`power_virus_dit`、`ooo_dep_chain_arm`、`lsu_store_forward_arm`、`l2c_cross_cache_line_arm`、`mmu_split_tlb_arm` | di/dt 电压骤降、乱序依赖链、LSU 转发、L2 跨行、MMU/TLB/页表遍历器 |
168	| ARM64 触发配方 | `agu_stress_2src`、`neon_rot_2src`、`neon_rot_ldr_at_top_rowmajor`、`movbe` 系列（`movbe`、`movbe_dump`、11 个 `movbe_dump_probe_*`） | AGU 吞吐施压（2 源加载 + 旋转 ALU + store/reload/store）、core-179 配方的 NEON 向量通路判别（uint64x2 旋转 ALU + 向量 store/reload/store）、ldr_at_top 扫描顺序变体（升/降序交替，区分槽位局部 vs 前进位置特征）、core-179 字节交换往返触发探针组 |
169	| IST 硬件自检 | `ist`、`ist_array`、`ist_sbaf` | ARM64 In-Silicon Test（当前 placeholder，见下表） |

# 集成 sve512_gather_scatter_arm 到 arm64 测试分类

日期：2026-09-14

## 背景

用户提供了一个新的 SVE gather/scather SDC 测试源文件（从 sve512_fma 研究
中单独提取的 workload 4）：

- `sve512_gather_scatter_arm.cpp` — SVE 全向量长度 gather/scatter 压力：
  `svld1_gather_u64index_f64`（按元素索引从置换索引表 gather）+
  `svmla_f64_x`（v = 1.5 + v*v）+ `svst1_scatter_u64index_f64`（按同一
  索引 scatter 回暂存区），与走同一间接索引的标量 golden 逐字节比较。
- 本机（Kunpeng 920）**无 SVE**（/proc/cpuinfo 实测无 sve 特性），用户
  要求编译通过即可，不要求本机跑通（test_init 入口即探测 HWCAP_SVE，
  无 SVE 时干净 EXIT_SKIP）。

## 决策

- 文件放入 `tests/cpu/arm64/`（整个子目录仅在 aarch64 构建，x86-64 不受
  影响）。
- **不并入 `tests_arm64` 库**：该库基线 `-march=armv8.1-a+crc+crypto` 不含
  +sve，`<arm_sve.h>` 内联函数无法编译；且不能给整个库加 +sve——GCC 会把
  其他 NEON 测试自动向量化成 SVE 指令，无 SVE 机器上 SIGILL。
- 在 `tests/cpu/arm64/meson.build` 新建独立静态库 `tests_arm64_sve`，
  `-march=armv8.2-a+sve`（与 tests/cpu/meson.build 已有 SVE 构建块相同的
  march 组合），仅含本文件。用户代码原样，零修改。
- 运行时安全：test_init 第一行即探测 HWCAP_SVE，失败即 return EXIT_SKIP，
  无 SVE 机器上不执行任何 SVE 指令。
- README.md 同步：用例总数以 `--list-tests` 实测数为准更新，ARM64 SDC
  专项表补该测试。

## One-patch-per-unit 分解

单个 unit（一个 commit）。

### Task 1: 集成 sve512_gather_scatter_arm

文件变更：
- 新建 `tests/cpu/arm64/sve512_gather_scatter_arm.cpp`（用户代码原样）
- `tests/cpu/arm64/meson.build`：新增 `tests_arm64_sve` 静态库块
- `README.md`：用例计数 + ARM64 SDC 专项表
- 本计划文件

验证（真实命令，引用真实输出）：
1. `ninja -C builddir` — 零新增 error/warning
2. `./builddir/sdcshield --list-tests | grep sve512_gather_scatter_arm` — 已注册
3. `./builddir/sdcshield -e sve512_gather_scatter_arm -t 1000` — 本机无 SVE，
   预期干净 skip（证明 HWCAP 守卫生效、无 SVE 指令泄漏到 skip 路径）
4. 回归：`./builddir/sdcshield -e zstd19 -t 3000` — `exit: pass`
5. x86-64 非回归：全部变更在 aarch64 guard 内（meson 检查确认）

- [ ] Task 1 完成

# openEuler 24.03（基准平台）依赖；Ubuntu/Fedora 见 docs/offline-build-dependencies.md
sudo dnf install -y meson ninja-build gcc g++ cmake boost-devel zlib-devel libzstd-devel gtest-devel
PKG_CONFIG_PATH=./third-party/eigen5 meson setup builddir --buildtype=release
ninja -C builddir
./builddir/sdcshield --list-tests        # 应列出 264 个 PROD 用例
```

> ARM64 要求 Eigen 5.0.0+（系统 Eigen 3.3.x 在 GCC 12+ 下编译失败）。仓库自带 `third-party/eigen5/`，aarch64 构建路径在 `tests/cpu/meson.build` 中直接 `include_directories` 指向它，**无需系统安装 eigen3**；`PKG_CONFIG_PATH` 仅为兼容 x86 路径而保留，带上无害。



## 离线与多版本构建

离线工具在 `scripts/offline-build/`。单机原生路径（`download-deps.sh`/`install-deps.sh`/`build.sh`，共享 `_common.sh`，用 `.os-version` 标记强制版本匹配）只支持 **24.03**——`_common.sh` 基线硬编码 `24.03LTS`，`detect_os_version_full` 对 22.03/20.03 会误报。22.03/20.03 必须走容器路径（D）。

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
tests/arm64: add sve512_gather_scatter_arm — SVE gather/scatter SDC stress

Standalone extraction of workload 4 from the sve512_fma research set:
svld1_gather_u64index_f64 (element-index gather from a permuted index
table) + svmla_f64_x (v = 1.5 + v*v) + svst1_scatter_u64index_f64
(scatter back through the same indirection), byte-exact compared against
a scalar golden that indexes through the same permutation (scatter does
not commute with the permutation, so the golden maps idx[i] -> dst).

Compiled into a new tests_arm64_sve static library with
-march=armv8.2-a+sve, separate from the armv8.1-a+crc+crypto baseline of
tests_arm64: enabling +sve for the whole library could let GCC
auto-vectorize the NEON tests into SVE, which would SIGILL on SVE-less
CPUs. Runtime safety is double-guarded: the framework's
compiler_minimum_device check skips before fork ("test compiled with
sve"), and test_init probes HWCAP_SVE via getauxval and returns a clean
EXIT_SKIP on SVE-less CPUs.

Verification (on top of origin/main 38eb721, Kunpeng 920 — no SVE):
- ninja: 318/318, zero new errors/warnings (single-TU recompile clean)
- --list-tests: registered; counts measured PROD 271 / +BETA 275 /
  +SKIP 280 (README updated accordingly)
- -e sve512_gather_scatter_arm -t 1000: result: skip,
  CpuNotSupported, no SIGILL — same framework-level skip as
  eigen_svd_cdouble_sve
- regression: zstd19 -t 3000 exit: pass
- SVE codegen confirmed by objdump: ld1d gather / fmad (svmla) / st1d
  scatter / cntd / ptrue all present in the TU
- x86-64 non-regression: all changes inside the aarch64-only meson
  guard; x86-64 build path never enters this subdir
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -2 && git status --short | head -8

The user asked why builddir/sdcshield is 250MB — is it carrying debug and symbols?

The evidence I've gathered:

1. `ls -lh builddir/sdcshield` → 249M, `file` says "with debug_info, not stripped"
2. `size` → text 2,968,820 (~2.8MB) — actual loadable code+data is only ~3MB
3. readelf -SW shows the debug sections:
   - .debug_info: 0x5cbc6c6 = 97,060,806 bytes ≈ 92.5 MB
   - .debug_abbrev: 0x10e51f = 1,105,439 ≈ 1.05 MB
   - .debug_line: 0x909ef8 = 9,478,128 ≈ 9.0 MB
   - .debug_str: 0x7549735 = 123,015,989 ≈ 117.2 MB
   - .debug_line_str: 0x5d8d = 24,077 ≈ 0.02 MB
   - .debug_loclists: 0x159304b = 22,558,539 ≈ 21.5 MB
   - .debug_rnglists: 0x38f9b2 = 3,735,986 ≈ 3.6 MB
   - .debug_aranges: 0x8c60 = 35,936 ≈ 0.03 MB
   - .symtab: 0x479b8 = 293,048 ≈ 0.28 MB

Let me add those up:
- .debug_info: 97,060,806
- .debug_str: 123,015,989
- .debug_loclists: 22,558,539
- .debug_line: 9,478,128
- .debug_rnglists: 3,735,986
- .debug_abbrev: 1,105,439
- others small: ~35,936 + 24,077 + 293,048 ≈ 353,061

Total ≈ 256,708,894 ≈ 245 MB of debug sections alone. Plus ~3MB of actual code. That accounts for the 249MB.

4. Why is debug info so large? The meson.build release branch uses `-g` (line 98-102: `-O3 -g -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2`). So even in release mode, the project passes -g. Also the project has `debug` option = false but buildtype release. The `debug_c_flags` for release includes `-g`.

Why so huge specifically here? The project statically links Eigen (header-only, heavily templated — Eigen 5 is massive with templates), Boost headers, zlib, zstd, and all the tests. Every template instantiation generates DWARF. Plus it's compiled with -O3 so lots of inlining → debug info for inlined code in every TU. The debug info from 318 object files gets merged at link.

```
file builddir/sdcshield:
  ... with debug_info, not stripped

size:   text=2,968,820  data=109,624  bss=17,184   ← 实际代码仅 ~3MB
```

| 段 | 大小 |

| `.debug_str` | **117.3 MB** |
| `.debug_info` | **92.7 MB** |

| `.debug_line` | 9.0 MB |

| **合计** | **~245 MB** |

`.debug_str`/`.debug_info` 巨大的主因：~280 个测试 TU 静态链入 + **Eigen5 / Boost 模板头**的实例化调试信息（模板重度库的典型表现）。

## 3. 根因：release 构建也带 `-g`

这不是 debug 构建（优化是 `-O3`），而是 `meson.build:97-103` 对 release 分支**无条件加了 `-g`**：

```meson
else   # release
    debug_c_flags = [
        '-O3',
        '-g',            ← 罪魁
        '-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2',
    ]
endif
```

## 4. 对照：发布产物就是它 strip 后的样子

- 随包发布二进制（`third-party/rpms/.../built/sdcshield`）：**2.8MB** —— `scripts/offline-build/package-built-artifacts.sh:44` 做了 `strip --strip-debug --strip-unneeded`
- 我实测 `strip` 一份本地副本：249M → **3.0MB**，与发布件一致

- 临时：`strip -o /tmp/sdcshield.slim builddir/sdcshield`（或 `objcopy --only-keep-debug` 做分离式调试文件）
- 构建：`meson configure builddir -Dstrip=true`（安装时 strip，builddir 内不变）
- 注意保留符号是有用途的：`--on-crash=context` 的崩溃回溯（`child_debug.cpp`）依赖符号信息做函数名/行号解析，现场排障时未 strip 的二进制回溯质量更高。发布管线 strip、开发机保留，是当前的设计分工。

1	#!/bin/bash
2	# container-build.sh — 在 podman openEuler 容器内离线构建 SDCShield-arm 并验证。
3	#
4	# 用法:
5	#   ./container-build.sh <series> <sp> [extra-meson-args...]
6	#     series: 24.03 | 22.03 | 20.03
7	#     sp   : LTS | SP1 | SP2 | SP3 | SP4
8	#
9	# 示例:
10	#   ./container-build.sh 24.03 SP3
11	#   ./container-build.sh 22.03 SP3
12	#   ./container-build.sh 20.03 SP4
13	#
14	# 设计要点(满足 CLAUDE.md 约束):
15	#   - 源码树只读挂载 (/src),容器内不可写 → 24.03 源码不可能被污染。
16	#   - 22.03/20.03 的全部适配通过 CXXFLAGS 注入:
17	#       -DOPENEULER_22.03 (或 OPENEULER_20.03)
18	#       -include /src/framework/compat/cpp23_polyfill.h   # polyfill,不改既有源码
19	#       (meson 的 -Dcpp_std=gnu++20 命令行覆盖,不改 meson.build)
20	#       -Denable_acl=disabled (22.03/20.03 ACL ABI 不兼容,见 meson_options.txt)
21	#   - meson_version:源码已声明 >=0.56(22.03 0.59 与 20.03 vendored 0.59.4 均满足),
22	#     无需 sed 放宽。
23	#   - 产物拷出到 host: build-out/openEuler-XX.03LTS_SPx/ (bin + log + ldd清单)。
24	#
25	# SPDX-License-Identifier-Identifier: Apache-2.0
26	set -euo pipefail
27	
28	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
29	SRC_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
30	
31	SERIES="${1:?usage: $0 <series> <sp> [meson-args]}"
32	SP="${2:?usage: $0 <series> <sp> [meson-args]}"
33	shift 2 || true
34	EXTRA_MESON=("$@")
35	
36	# 规范化 SP 标签(镜像 tag 用 LTS-SPx,目录名用 LTS_SPx)
37	case "$SP" in
38	    LTS)   SP_LABEL="LTS";    SP_DIR="LTS" ;;
39	    SP[1-4]) SP_LABEL="LTS-$SP"; SP_DIR="LTS_$SP" ;;
40	    *) echo "bad SP: $SP" >&2; exit 1 ;;
41	esac
42	
43	OS_TAG="openEuler-${SERIES}${SP_DIR}"
44	IMG="localhost/openeuler-offline:${SERIES}-${SP_LABEL}"
45	RPMDIR_HOST="$SRC_ROOT/third-party/rpms/openEuler-${SERIES}/${OS_TAG}/rpms"
46	OUTDIR_HOST="$SRC_ROOT/build-out/${OS_TAG}"
47	
48	[ -d "$RPMDIR_HOST" ] || { echo "RPM dir missing: $RPMDIR_HOST" >&2; exit 1; }
49	ls "$RPMDIR_HOST"/*.rpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "no rpms in $RPMDIR_HOST" >&2; exit 1; }
50	
51	echo "==> 镜像: $IMG"
52	echo "==> RPM 目录(host): $RPMDIR_HOST"
53	echo "==> 产物输出(host): $OUTDIR_HOST"
54	
55	# host 端准备输出目录
56	mkdir -p "$OUTDIR_HOST"
57	
58	# 容器内入口脚本:装依赖 + 构建 + 测试,所有产物落 /out (映射到 host OUTDIR)
59	# inner-build.sh 用 SP-specific 路径(并发 worker 各自一份,避免覆盖竞态)。
60	INNER=/tmp/inner-build.sh
61	INNER_HOST="$SRC_ROOT/build-out/inner-build-${OS_TAG}.sh"
62	cat > "$INNER_HOST" <<'INNER_EOF'
63	#!/bin/bash
64	set -euo pipefail
65	
66	# 从容器 env 读参数(OS_TAG, EXTRA_MESON 数组, OS_SERIES)
67	RPMDIR="/rpms"
68	SRC="/src"
69	BUILD="/build"
70	OUT="/out"
71	
72	# 创建构建工作目录 (容器内可写) + /var/tmp (最小镜像缺, rpm %trigger 脚本需要)
73	mkdir -p "$BUILD" "$OUT" /var/tmp /tmp
74	
75	# ===== 杠杆 1: 镜像已烘焙依赖则跳过安装 =====
76	# 由 build-images.sh 构建的镜像(localhost/openeuler-offline:...)在镜像层里已
77	# rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force 装完整棵依赖树 + 建 ld 链接(见 Containerfile.template)。
78	# 检测信号: 镜像自带 find + gcc → deps 已就绪, 跳过 [1/5] 整段安装, 直接进 toolset 激活。
79	# (20.03 的 /usr/bin/gcc 可能是 gcc-7 或缺失, 但 toolset 激活块会用 /opt/.../gcc-10
80	#  覆盖 PATH/CC/CXX; 那是"怎么用 deps"不是"装 deps", 仍要跑。故此处只判 find。)
81	if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
82	    echo "===== [1/5] 依赖已就绪(镜像烘焙) — 跳过安装 ====="
83	    echo "  gcc: $(gcc --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo 'toolset 激活后见下')"
84	else
85	    echo "===== [1/5] 离线安装依赖 ($RPMDIR) ====="
86	    # 最小镜像缺 find, 先用 rpm 直装 findutils (--nodeps, 依赖已在镜像)。
87	    FINDUTILS_RPM=$(ls "$RPMDIR"/findutils-*.rpm 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
88	    if [ -n "$FINDUTILS_RPM" ] && ! command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
89	        echo "  预装 findutils (镜像缺 find)..."
90	        rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force "$FINDUTILS_RPM" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
91	    fi
92	    command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: find 仍不可用" >&2; exit 1; }
93	
94	    # 容器是最小化 KIWI 镜像, 系统包(util-linux/libuuid 等)版本与 RPM 树来源子版本号
95	    # 略有差异(如 -31 vs -39), dnf 的精确版本依赖会触发 "protected dnf" 死结。
96	    # 容器是可丢弃环境, 用 rpm --nodeps --force 直接强装整棵依赖树(等价于
97	    # install-deps.sh 的兜底方案 4), 依赖物理上都在 RPM 树里, 强装后能正常工作。
98	    EXCLUDE_RE='grub2|shim|mokutil|efivar|dracut|kpartx|fuse|glibc$|glibc-common|glibc-headers|glibc-static|systemd$|systemd-libs|systemd-udev|setup$|filesystem$|basesystem|shadow|pam|crypto-policies|openEuler-release|openEuler-gpg|openEuler-repos'
99	    KEEP=$(find "$RPMDIR" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.rpm' | grep -ivE "$EXCLUDE_RE")
100	    echo "  强装 $(echo "$KEEP" | wc -l) 个 RPM (--nodeps --force)..."
101	    rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force $KEEP >/tmp/rpm-install.log 2>&1 || true
102	
103	    # 大批量 --nodeps --force 会因文件冲突静默跳过部分关键包(如 glibc-devel 提供
104	    # crt1.o, binutils 提供 ld)。显式重装这几个关键包, 保证 toolset gcc 能链接。
105	    # 注: 某些包(如 glibc-headers)在 20.03 不存在, ls 无匹配会非零退出 → 用 || true
106	    # 兜底, 否则 set -e 会中断脚本。
107	    for mustpkg in glibc-devel glibc-headers binutils gcc-toolset-10-gcc gcc-toolset-10-gcc-c++ gcc-toolset-10-libstdc++-devel gcc-toolset-10-libgcc; do
108	        f=$(ls "$RPMDIR"/${mustpkg}-*.rpm 2>/dev/null | head -1) || true
109	        [ -n "$f" ] && rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
110	    done
111	    echo "  安装完成; gcc 版本: $(gcc --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo MISSING)"
112	
113	    # 20.03 + 22.03 的最小镜像缺 ld 符号链接: binutils 装了 ld.bfd 但
114	    # /usr/bin/ld → /etc/alternatives/ld 的 alternatives 链未建(--nodeps 跳了
115	    # %post 脚本依赖的 chkconfig/alternatives)。手动建直链, 让 collect2 找到 ld。
116	    if [ ! -e /usr/bin/ld ] && [ -e /usr/bin/ld.bfd ]; then
117	        ln -sf /usr/bin/ld.bfd /usr/bin/ld
118	        echo "  建 /usr/bin/ld → ld.bfd 符号链接"
119	    fi
120	fi
121	
122	# 20.03: gcc-10 以 SCL gcc-toolset-10 形式安装(在 /opt/openEuler/gcc-toolset-10/root/)。
123	# 系统默认 gcc 是 7.3(无 C++20/23)。激活 toolset: 把其 bin 加 PATH, 设 CC/CXX,
124	# 设 lib/include 搜索路径(LDFLAGS/CPPFLAGS/-isystem), 让 meson 用 gcc-10 而非 gcc-7。
125	TOOLSET_ROOT="/opt/openEuler/gcc-toolset-10/root"
126	if [ -n "${OPENEULER_MACRO:-}" ] && [ -d "$TOOLSET_ROOT/usr/bin" ]; then
127	    TS_BIN="$TOOLSET_ROOT/usr/bin"
128	    # toolset 的 gcc/g++ 二进制名为 gcc/g++(非 gcc-10); 加 PATH 优先于系统 gcc-7
129	    export PATH="$TS_BIN:$PATH"
130	    export CC="$TS_BIN/gcc"
131	    export CXX="$TS_BIN/g++"
132	    # toolset 的 libstdc++ 头/库在 root/usr/include 与 root/usr/lib64
133	    TS_LIB="$TOOLSET_ROOT/usr/lib64"
134	    export LDFLAGS="-L$TS_LIB -Wl,-rpath,$TS_LIB ${LDFLAGS:-}"
135	    # 让 meson 的 cpp.check_header / dependency 能找到 toolset 的 boost/gmp 等
136	    export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$TOOLSET_ROOT/usr/lib64/pkgconfig:${PKG_CONFIG_PATH:-}"
137	    echo "  激活 gcc-toolset-10: $(gcc --version 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
138	    echo "  CC=$CC CXX=$CXX"
139	fi
140	
141	echo "===== [2/5] 工具链自检 ====="
142	for cmd in gcc g++ meson ninja perl python3 pkg-config ar; do
143	    printf "  %-9s %s\n" "$cmd" "$($cmd --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo MISSING)"
144	done
145	
146	echo "===== [3/5] meson setup ====="
147	# 把只读 /src 拷一份到可写 /build/src(供 meson setup 用,不再 sed 改源码)。
148	cp -a "$SRC" "$BUILD/src"
149	SRCW="$BUILD/src"
150	
151	# meson_version:源码已声明 >=0.56(project_source_root 引入版,22.03 的 0.59 与
152	# 20.03 vendored 0.59.4 均满足),无需再 sed 放宽。
153	
154	# udf 助记符:源码已用 .inst 0x00001234(.inst 伪指令,新旧 binutils 统一支持,
155	# 同 UDF #0x1234 编码,同 SIGILL)。无需再 sed-patch。见 selftest.cpp 注释。
156	
157	# std::string/string_view::contains (C++23, GCC10 缺):源码 3 个调用点已改为
158	# 可移植的 .find()==npos 比较(C++17, GCC10/12 通用)。无需再 sed-patch。
159	# 注: std::map::contains (C++20) GCC10 已支持, 不在涉及范围内。
160	
161	# ACL (Arm Compute Library) 收敛:用 meson option -Denable_acl 替代 sed 改源码。
162	# 22.03/20.03 的 ACL 原生库是 v20.02 (GCC10 libstdc++), 与 host 头 (v22.11,
163	# GCC12) ABI 不兼容, fisttp_arm 链接失败 (undefined GLIBCXX_3.4.29/3.4.30)。
164	# 故 22.03/20.03 传 -Denable_acl=disabled (meson.build 里 acl_sources=[] 空库,
165	# 不链 -larm_compute, 跳过 2 ACL 测试)。24.03 不传 = auto (host 有 ACL 则构建)。
166	ACL_OPT=""
167	if [ -n "${OPENEULER_MACRO:-}" ]; then
168	    ACL_OPT="-Denable_acl=disabled"
169	    echo "  ACL: -Denable_acl=disabled (22.03/20.03 跳过 2 ACL 测试)"
170	fi
171	
172	# CXXFLAGS 注入 polyfill 头 + 版本宏 + compat/ 系统头路径 (只对 22.03/20.03;24.03 不注入)
173	# -isystem compat: 让源码里的 #include <barrier> 命中 compat/barrier shim(GCC10 无该头)
174	# -include unistd.h: GCC10 头文件卫生比 GCC12 严, 部分 ARM64 测试源码
175	#   (vector/kreg1.cpp/kreg2.cpp/insert_extract.cpp) 调 getpid() 但未 #include <unistd.h>;
176	#   GCC12 靠传递包含放过, GCC10 报 "not declared"。用 -include unistd.h 无害兜底
177	#   (不改动任何既有源码行, 仅在 22.03/20.03 构建注入)。
178	POLYFILL_HDR="$SRCW/framework/compat/cpp23_polyfill.h"
179	COMPAT_DIR="$SRCW/framework/compat"
180	CXXFLAGS_EXTRA=""
181	if [ -n "${OPENEULER_MACRO:-}" ] && [ -f "$POLYFILL_HDR" ]; then
182	    CXXFLAGS_EXTRA="-D${OPENEULER_MACRO} -include $POLYFILL_HDR -include unistd.h -isystem $COMPAT_DIR"
183	    echo "  注入: $CXXFLAGS_EXTRA"
184	fi
185	
186	export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$SRCW/third-party/eigen5"
187	# CXXFLAGS 让 meson 合并 -D/-include 到 cpp_args
188	export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS_EXTRA} ${CXXFLAGS:-}"
189	export CPPSTD="${CPPSTD:-gnu++23}"
190	
191	rm -rf "$BUILD/builddir"
192	meson_setup() { ${MESON_BIN:-meson} "$@"; }
193	meson_setup setup "$BUILD/builddir" "$SRCW" --buildtype=release -Dcpp_std="$CPPSTD" $ACL_OPT ${EXTRA_MESON_ARGS:-}
194	
195	echo "===== [4/5] ninja ====="
196	ninja -C "$BUILD/builddir"
197	
198	BIN="$BUILD/builddir/sdcshield"
199	echo "===== [5/5] 功能验证 ====="
200	ls -la "$BIN"
201	N=$("$BIN" --list-tests 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
202	echo "list-tests: $N"
203	[ "$N" -gt 100 ] || { echo "ERROR: too few tests ($N)" >&2; exit 1; }
204	
205	echo "--- zstd19 -n 1 ---"
206	"$BIN" -e zstd19 -t 2000 -n 1 2>&1 | grep -iE "exit|result" | head -3 || true
207	
208	# 拷产物到 /out
209	cp "$BIN" "$OUT/sdcshield"
210	ldd "$BIN" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u > "$OUT/ldd-libs.txt" || true
211	echo "===== 容器内构建完成 ====="
212	INNER_EOF
213	chmod +x "$INNER_HOST"
214	
215	# 决定注入宏与 cpp_std
216	# 注: 宏名用 OPENEULER_22_03 / OPENEULER_20_03 (点号→下划线),因 C 预处理器宏标识符
217	# 不允许含点号 ('.')。语义与目标意图一致,仅隔离 22.03/20.03 适配,不触碰 24.03。
218	# 20.03 特殊: 系统自带 meson 0.54 + python3.7 太旧(meson 0.59 RPM 也跑不动,需
219	# importlib.metadata / py3.8+)。故 20.03 用 meson 0.59.4 源码包(入仓
220	# third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4, 纯 Python, 兼容 py3.7)直接 python3 meson.py 运行。
221	case "$SERIES" in
222	    24.03) OEU_MACRO="";        CPPSTD="gnu++23"; MESON_BIN="meson" ;;
223	    22.03) OEU_MACRO="OPENEULER_22_03"; CPPSTD="gnu++20"; MESON_BIN="meson" ;;
224	    20.03) OEU_MACRO="OPENEULER_20_03"; CPPSTD="gnu++20"; MESON_BIN="python3 /meson-src/meson.py" ;;

227	
228	# extra meson args (数组转空格串)
229	echo "==> 启动 podman 容器构建..."
230	# ACL(arithmetic_arm 测试)的 host 路径(bind 挂到同名位置, meson 用 -Dacl_incdir 找):

232	#   - 库: /usr/lib64/libarm_compute.so
233	#   - clang-rt builtins: /usr/lib/clang/17/lib/aarch64-openEuler-linux-gnu/libclang_rt.builtins.a

239	CLANG_RT="/usr/lib/clang/17"

243	# 否则 SELinux enforcing 系统会 "Permission denied"(与 verify-built-pristine.sh 一致)。
244	MOUNTS=(-v "$SRC_ROOT:/src:ro,Z" -v "$RPMDIR_HOST:/rpms:ro,Z" -v "$OUTDIR_HOST:/out:Z" -v "$INNER_HOST:$INNER:ro,Z")
245	# 20.03 用 meson 源码包 (RPM 版的 meson 0.59 跑不动于 python3.7)。
246	# 源码包入仓 third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4(11M, 纯源码, 可复现)。
247	[ "$SERIES" = "20.03" ] && [ -d "$SRC_ROOT/third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4" ] && \
248	    MOUNTS+=(-v "$SRC_ROOT/third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4:/meson-src:ro")
249	[ -d "$ACL_HDR" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$ACL_HDR:$ACL_HDR:ro")
250	[ -d "$ACL_LIB" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute.so:$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute.so:ro" -v "$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute_graph.so:$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute_graph.so:ro")
251	[ -d "$CLANG_RT" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$CLANG_RT:$CLANG_RT:ro")
252	
253	timeout 1200 podman run --rm --user=0 \
254	    "${MOUNTS[@]}" \
255	    -e OPENEULER_MACRO="$OEU_MACRO" \
256	    -e CPPSTD="$CPPSTD" \
257	    -e EXTRA_MESON_ARGS="$EXTRA_MESON_STR" \
258	    -e MESON_BIN="$MESON_BIN" \
259	    "$IMG" \
260	    bash "$INNER"
261	
262	echo "==> 产物在: $OUTDIR_HOST"
263	ls -la "$OUTDIR_HOST"

#   ./container-build.sh 20.03 SP4
#
# 设计要点(满足 CLAUDE.md 约束):
#   - 源码树只读挂载 (/src),容器内不可写 → 24.03 源码不可能被污染。
#   - 22.03/20.03 的全部适配通过 CXXFLAGS 注入:
#       -DOPENEULER_22.03 (或 OPENEULER_20.03)
#       -include /src/framework/compat/cpp23_polyfill.h   # polyfill,不改既有源码
#       (meson 的 -Dcpp_std=gnu++20 命令行覆盖,不改 meson.build)
#       -Denable_acl=disabled (22.03/20.03 ACL ABI 不兼容,见 meson_options.txt)
#   - meson_version:源码已声明 >=0.56(22.03 0.59 与 20.03 vendored 0.59.4 均满足),
#     无需 sed 放宽。
#   - 产物拷出到 host: build-out/openEuler-XX.03LTS_SPx/ (bin + log + ldd清单)。
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier-Identifier: Apache-2.0
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
SRC_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

SERIES="${1:?usage: $0 <series> <sp> [meson-args]}"
SP="${2:?usage: $0 <series> <sp> [meson-args]}"
shift 2 || true
EXTRA_MESON=("$@")

# 规范化 SP 标签(镜像 tag 用 LTS-SPx,目录名用 LTS_SPx)
case "$SP" in
    LTS)   SP_LABEL="LTS";    SP_DIR="LTS" ;;
    SP[1-4]) SP_LABEL="LTS-$SP"; SP_DIR="LTS_$SP" ;;
    *) echo "bad SP: $SP" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

OS_TAG="openEuler-${SERIES}${SP_DIR}"
IMG="localhost/openeuler-offline:${SERIES}-${SP_LABEL}"
RPMDIR_HOST="$SRC_ROOT/third-party/rpms/openEuler-${SERIES}/${OS_TAG}/rpms"
OUTDIR_HOST="$SRC_ROOT/build-out/${OS_TAG}"

[ -d "$RPMDIR_HOST" ] || { echo "RPM dir missing: $RPMDIR_HOST" >&2; exit 1; }
ls "$RPMDIR_HOST"/*.rpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "no rpms in $RPMDIR_HOST" >&2; exit 1; }

echo "==> 镜像: $IMG"
echo "==> RPM 目录(host): $RPMDIR_HOST"
echo "==> 产物输出(host): $OUTDIR_HOST"

# host 端准备输出目录
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR_HOST"

# 容器内入口脚本:装依赖 + 构建 + 测试,所有产物落 /out (映射到 host OUTDIR)
# inner-build.sh 用 SP-specific 路径(并发 worker 各自一份,避免覆盖竞态)。
INNER=/tmp/inner-build.sh
INNER_HOST="$SRC_ROOT/build-out/inner-build-${OS_TAG}.sh"
cat > "$INNER_HOST" <<'INNER_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# 从容器 env 读参数(OS_TAG, EXTRA_MESON 数组, OS_SERIES)
RPMDIR="/rpms"
SRC="/src"
BUILD="/build"
OUT="/out"

# 创建构建工作目录 (容器内可写) + /var/tmp (最小镜像缺, rpm %trigger 脚本需要)
mkdir -p "$BUILD" "$OUT" /var/tmp /tmp

# ===== 杠杆 1: 镜像已烘焙依赖则跳过安装 =====
# 由 build-images.sh 构建的镜像(localhost/openeuler-offline:...)在镜像层里已
# rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force 装完整棵依赖树 + 建 ld 链接(见 Containerfile.template)。
# 检测信号: 镜像自带 find + gcc → deps 已就绪, 跳过 [1/5] 整段安装, 直接进 toolset 激活。
# (20.03 的 /usr/bin/gcc 可能是 gcc-7 或缺失, 但 toolset 激活块会用 /opt/.../gcc-10
#  覆盖 PATH/CC/CXX; 那是"怎么用 deps"不是"装 deps", 仍要跑。故此处只判 find。)
if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "===== [1/5] 依赖已就绪(镜像烘焙) — 跳过安装 ====="
    echo "  gcc: $(gcc --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo 'toolset 激活后见下')"
else
    echo "===== [1/5] 离线安装依赖 ($RPMDIR) ====="
    # 最小镜像缺 find, 先用 rpm 直装 findutils (--nodeps, 依赖已在镜像)。
    FINDUTILS_RPM=$(ls "$RPMDIR"/findutils-*.rpm 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
    if [ -n "$FINDUTILS_RPM" ] && ! command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "  预装 findutils (镜像缺 find)..."
        rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force "$FINDUTILS_RPM" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
    command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: find 仍不可用" >&2; exit 1; }

    # 容器是最小化 KIWI 镜像, 系统包(util-linux/libuuid 等)版本与 RPM 树来源子版本号
    # 略有差异(如 -31 vs -39), dnf 的精确版本依赖会触发 "protected dnf" 死结。
    # 容器是可丢弃环境, 用 rpm --nodeps --force 直接强装整棵依赖树(等价于
    # install-deps.sh 的兜底方案 4), 依赖物理上都在 RPM 树里, 强装后能正常工作。
    EXCLUDE_RE='grub2|shim|mokutil|efivar|dracut|kpartx|fuse|glibc$|glibc-common|glibc-headers|glibc-static|systemd$|systemd-libs|systemd-udev|setup$|filesystem$|basesystem|shadow|pam|crypto-policies|openEuler-release|openEuler-gpg|openEuler-repos'
    KEEP=$(find "$RPMDIR" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.rpm' | grep -ivE "$EXCLUDE_RE")
    echo "  强装 $(echo "$KEEP" | wc -l) 个 RPM (--nodeps --force)..."
    rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force $KEEP >/tmp/rpm-install.log 2>&1 || true

    # 大批量 --nodeps --force 会因文件冲突静默跳过部分关键包(如 glibc-devel 提供
    # crt1.o, binutils 提供 ld)。显式重装这几个关键包, 保证 toolset gcc 能链接。
    # 注: 某些包(如 glibc-headers)在 20.03 不存在, ls 无匹配会非零退出 → 用 || true
    # 兜底, 否则 set -e 会中断脚本。
    for mustpkg in glibc-devel glibc-headers binutils gcc-toolset-10-gcc gcc-toolset-10-gcc-c++ gcc-toolset-10-libstdc++-devel gcc-toolset-10-libgcc; do
        f=$(ls "$RPMDIR"/${mustpkg}-*.rpm 2>/dev/null | head -1) || true
        [ -n "$f" ] && rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    done
    echo "  安装完成; gcc 版本: $(gcc --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo MISSING)"

    # 20.03 + 22.03 的最小镜像缺 ld 符号链接: binutils 装了 ld.bfd 但
    # /usr/bin/ld → /etc/alternatives/ld 的 alternatives 链未建(--nodeps 跳了
    # %post 脚本依赖的 chkconfig/alternatives)。手动建直链, 让 collect2 找到 ld。
    if [ ! -e /usr/bin/ld ] && [ -e /usr/bin/ld.bfd ]; then
        ln -sf /usr/bin/ld.bfd /usr/bin/ld
        echo "  建 /usr/bin/ld → ld.bfd 符号链接"
    fi
fi

# 20.03: gcc-10 以 SCL gcc-toolset-10 形式安装(在 /opt/openEuler/gcc-toolset-10/root/)。
# 系统默认 gcc 是 7.3(无 C++20/23)。激活 toolset: 把其 bin 加 PATH, 设 CC/CXX,
# 设 lib/include 搜索路径(LDFLAGS/CPPFLAGS/-isystem), 让 meson 用 gcc-10 而非 gcc-7。
TOOLSET_ROOT="/opt/openEuler/gcc-toolset-10/root"
if [ -n "${OPENEULER_MACRO:-}" ] && [ -d "$TOOLSET_ROOT/usr/bin" ]; then
    TS_BIN="$TOOLSET_ROOT/usr/bin"
    # toolset 的 gcc/g++ 二进制名为 gcc/g++(非 gcc-10); 加 PATH 优先于系统 gcc-7
    export PATH="$TS_BIN:$PATH"
    export CC="$TS_BIN/gcc"
    export CXX="$TS_BIN/g++"
    # toolset 的 libstdc++ 头/库在 root/usr/include 与 root/usr/lib64
    TS_LIB="$TOOLSET_ROOT/usr/lib64"
    export LDFLAGS="-L$TS_LIB -Wl,-rpath,$TS_LIB ${LDFLAGS:-}"
    # 让 meson 的 cpp.check_header / dependency 能找到 toolset 的 boost/gmp 等
    export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$TOOLSET_ROOT/usr/lib64/pkgconfig:${PKG_CONFIG_PATH:-}"
    echo "  激活 gcc-toolset-10: $(gcc --version 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
    echo "  CC=$CC CXX=$CXX"
fi

echo "===== [2/5] 工具链自检 ====="
for cmd in gcc g++ meson ninja perl python3 pkg-config ar; do
    printf "  %-9s %s\n" "$cmd" "$($cmd --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo MISSING)"
done

echo "===== [3/5] meson setup ====="
# 把只读 /src 拷一份到可写 /build/src(供 meson setup 用,不再 sed 改源码)。
cp -a "$SRC" "$BUILD/src"
SRCW="$BUILD/src"

# meson_version:源码已声明 >=0.56(project_source_root 引入版,22.03 的 0.59 与
# 20.03 vendored 0.59.4 均满足),无需再 sed 放宽。

# udf 助记符:源码已用 .inst 0x00001234(.inst 伪指令,新旧 binutils 统一支持,
# 同 UDF #0x1234 编码,同 SIGILL)。无需再 sed-patch。见 selftest.cpp 注释。

# std::string/string_view::contains (C++23, GCC10 缺):源码 3 个调用点已改为
# 可移植的 .find()==npos 比较(C++17, GCC10/12 通用)。无需再 sed-patch。
# 注: std::map::contains (C++20) GCC10 已支持, 不在涉及范围内。

# ACL (Arm Compute Library) 收敛:用 meson option -Denable_acl 替代 sed 改源码。
# 22.03/20.03 的 ACL 原生库是 v20.02 (GCC10 libstdc++), 与 host 头 (v22.11,
# GCC12) ABI 不兼容, fisttp_arm 链接失败 (undefined GLIBCXX_3.4.29/3.4.30)。
# 故 22.03/20.03 传 -Denable_acl=disabled (meson.build 里 acl_sources=[] 空库,
# 不链 -larm_compute, 跳过 2 ACL 测试)。24.03 不传 = auto (host 有 ACL 则构建)。
ACL_OPT=""
if [ -n "${OPENEULER_MACRO:-}" ]; then
    ACL_OPT="-Denable_acl=disabled"
    echo "  ACL: -Denable_acl=disabled (22.03/20.03 跳过 2 ACL 测试)"
fi

# CXXFLAGS 注入 polyfill 头 + 版本宏 + compat/ 系统头路径 (只对 22.03/20.03;24.03 不注入)
# -isystem compat: 让源码里的 #include <barrier> 命中 compat/barrier shim(GCC10 无该头)
# -include unistd.h: GCC10 头文件卫生比 GCC12 严, 部分 ARM64 测试源码
#   (vector/kreg1.cpp/kreg2.cpp/insert_extract.cpp) 调 getpid() 但未 #include <unistd.h>;
#   GCC12 靠传递包含放过, GCC10 报 "not declared"。用 -include unistd.h 无害兜底
#   (不改动任何既有源码行, 仅在 22.03/20.03 构建注入)。
POLYFILL_HDR="$SRCW/framework/compat/cpp23_polyfill.h"
COMPAT_DIR="$SRCW/framework/compat"
CXXFLAGS_EXTRA=""
if [ -n "${OPENEULER_MACRO:-}" ] && [ -f "$POLYFILL_HDR" ]; then
    CXXFLAGS_EXTRA="-D${OPENEULER_MACRO} -include $POLYFILL_HDR -include unistd.h -isystem $COMPAT_DIR"
    echo "  注入: $CXXFLAGS_EXTRA"
fi

export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$SRCW/third-party/eigen5"
# CXXFLAGS 让 meson 合并 -D/-include 到 cpp_args
export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS_EXTRA} ${CXXFLAGS:-}"
export CPPSTD="${CPPSTD:-gnu++23}"

rm -rf "$BUILD/builddir"
meson_setup() { ${MESON_BIN:-meson} "$@"; }
meson_setup setup "$BUILD/builddir" "$SRCW" --buildtype=release -Dcpp_std="$CPPSTD" $ACL_OPT ${EXTRA_MESON_ARGS:-}

echo "===== [4/5] ninja ====="
ninja -C "$BUILD/builddir"

BIN="$BUILD/builddir/sdcshield"
echo "===== [5/5] 功能验证 ====="
ls -la "$BIN"
N=$("$BIN" --list-tests 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "list-tests: $N"
[ "$N" -gt 100 ] || { echo "ERROR: too few tests ($N)" >&2; exit 1; }

echo "--- zstd19 -n 1 ---"
"$BIN" -e zstd19 -t 2000 -n 1 2>&1 | grep -iE "exit|result" | head -3 || true

# 拷产物到 /out
cp "$BIN" "$OUT/sdcshield"
ldd "$BIN" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u > "$OUT/ldd-libs.txt" || true
echo "===== 容器内构建完成 ====="
INNER_EOF
chmod +x "$INNER_HOST"

# 决定注入宏与 cpp_std
# 注: 宏名用 OPENEULER_22_03 / OPENEULER_20_03 (点号→下划线),因 C 预处理器宏标识符
# 不允许含点号 ('.')。语义与目标意图一致,仅隔离 22.03/20.03 适配,不触碰 24.03。
# 20.03 特殊: 系统自带 meson 0.54 + python3.7 太旧(meson 0.59 RPM 也跑不动,需
# importlib.metadata / py3.8+)。故 20.03 用 meson 0.59.4 源码包(入仓
# third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4, 纯 Python, 兼容 py3.7)直接 python3 meson.py 运行。
case "$SERIES" in
    24.03) OEU_MACRO="";        CPPSTD="gnu++23"; MESON_BIN="meson" ;;
    22.03) OEU_MACRO="OPENEULER_22_03"; CPPSTD="gnu++20"; MESON_BIN="meson" ;;
    20.03) OEU_MACRO="OPENEULER_20_03"; CPPSTD="gnu++20"; MESON_BIN="python3 /meson-src/meson.py" ;;
    *) echo "bad series"; exit 1 ;;
esac

# extra meson args (数组转空格串)
echo "==> 启动 podman 容器构建..."
# ACL(arithmetic_arm 测试)的 host 路径(bind 挂到同名位置, meson 用 -Dacl_incdir 找):
#   - 头: /home/sdc/root/arm64-sdc-fuzzing/third_party/arm-opt-install/include
#   - 库: /usr/lib64/libarm_compute.so
#   - clang-rt builtins: /usr/lib/clang/17/lib/aarch64-openEuler-linux-gnu/libclang_rt.builtins.a
# 仅当 host 上存在时挂载(24.03 容器镜像 == host 同 SP, 这些路径有效)。
# 24.03 传 -Dacl_incdir=<host path> 让 meson auto 找到 ACL 头;22.03/20.03 容器内
# 传 -Denable_acl=disabled(见 inner-build.sh)。
ACL_HDR="/home/sdc/root/arm64-sdc-fuzzing/third_party/arm-opt-install/include"
ACL_LIB="/usr/lib64"
CLANG_RT="/usr/lib/clang/17"
[ -d "$ACL_HDR" ] && EXTRA_MESON+=("-Dacl_incdir=$ACL_HDR")
EXTRA_MESON_STR="${EXTRA_MESON[*]:-}"
# :Z 让 podman 给挂载点打 SELinux 私有标签(容器可 exec 挂载的脚本/二进制),
# 否则 SELinux enforcing 系统会 "Permission denied"(与 verify-built-pristine.sh 一致)。
MOUNTS=(-v "$SRC_ROOT:/src:ro,Z" -v "$RPMDIR_HOST:/rpms:ro,Z" -v "$OUTDIR_HOST:/out:Z" -v "$INNER_HOST:$INNER:ro,Z")
# 20.03 用 meson 源码包 (RPM 版的 meson 0.59 跑不动于 python3.7)。
# 源码包入仓 third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4(11M, 纯源码, 可复现)。
[ "$SERIES" = "20.03" ] && [ -d "$SRC_ROOT/third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4" ] && \
    MOUNTS+=(-v "$SRC_ROOT/third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4:/meson-src:ro")
[ -d "$ACL_HDR" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$ACL_HDR:$ACL_HDR:ro")
[ -d "$ACL_LIB" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute.so:$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute.so:ro" -v "$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute_graph.so:$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute_graph.so:ro")
[ -d "$CLANG_RT" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$CLANG_RT:$CLANG_RT:ro")

timeout 1200 podman run --rm --user=0 \
    "${MOUNTS[@]}" \
    -e OPENEULER_MACRO="$OEU_MACRO" \
    -e CPPSTD="$CPPSTD" \
    -e EXTRA_MESON_ARGS="$EXTRA_MESON_STR" \
    -e MESON_BIN="$MESON_BIN" \
    "$IMG" \
    bash "$INNER"

echo "==> 产物在: $OUTDIR_HOST"
ls -la "$OUTDIR_HOST"

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# 从容器 env 读参数(OS_TAG, EXTRA_MESON 数组, OS_SERIES)
RPMDIR="/rpms"
SRC="/src"
BUILD="/build"
OUT="/out"

# 创建构建工作目录 (容器内可写) + /var/tmp (最小镜像缺, rpm %trigger 脚本需要)
mkdir -p "$BUILD" "$OUT" /var/tmp /tmp

# ===== 杠杆 1: 镜像已烘焙依赖则跳过安装 =====
# 由 build-images.sh 构建的镜像(localhost/openeuler-offline:...)在镜像层里已
# rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force 装完整棵依赖树 + 建 ld 链接(见 Containerfile.template)。
# 检测信号: 镜像自带 find + gcc → deps 已就绪, 跳过 [1/5] 整段安装, 直接进 toolset 激活。
# (20.03 的 /usr/bin/gcc 可能是 gcc-7 或缺失, 但 toolset 激活块会用 /opt/.../gcc-10
#  覆盖 PATH/CC/CXX; 那是"怎么用 deps"不是"装 deps", 仍要跑。故此处只判 find。)
if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "===== [1/5] 依赖已就绪(镜像烘焙) — 跳过安装 ====="
    echo "  gcc: $(gcc --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo 'toolset 激活后见下')"
else
    echo "===== [1/5] 离线安装依赖 ($RPMDIR) ====="
    # 最小镜像缺 find, 先用 rpm 直装 findutils (--nodeps, 依赖已在镜像)。
    FINDUTILS_RPM=$(ls "$RPMDIR"/findutils-*.rpm 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
    if [ -n "$FINDUTILS_RPM" ] && ! command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "  预装 findutils (镜像缺 find)..."
        rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force "$FINDUTILS_RPM" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
    command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: find 仍不可用" >&2; exit 1; }

    # 容器是最小化 KIWI 镜像, 系统包(util-linux/libuuid 等)版本与 RPM 树来源子版本号
    # 略有差异(如 -31 vs -39), dnf 的精确版本依赖会触发 "protected dnf" 死结。
    # 容器是可丢弃环境, 用 rpm --nodeps --force 直接强装整棵依赖树(等价于
    # install-deps.sh 的兜底方案 4), 依赖物理上都在 RPM 树里, 强装后能正常工作。
    EXCLUDE_RE='grub2|shim|mokutil|efivar|dracut|kpartx|fuse|glibc$|glibc-common|glibc-headers|glibc-static|systemd$|systemd-libs|systemd-udev|setup$|filesystem$|basesystem|shadow|pam|crypto-policies|openEuler-release|openEuler-gpg|openEuler-repos'
    KEEP=$(find "$RPMDIR" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.rpm' | grep -ivE "$EXCLUDE_RE")
    echo "  强装 $(echo "$KEEP" | wc -l) 个 RPM (--nodeps --force)..."
    rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force $KEEP >/tmp/rpm-install.log 2>&1 || true

    # 大批量 --nodeps --force 会因文件冲突静默跳过部分关键包(如 glibc-devel 提供
    # crt1.o, binutils 提供 ld)。显式重装这几个关键包, 保证 toolset gcc 能链接。
    # 注: 某些包(如 glibc-headers)在 20.03 不存在, ls 无匹配会非零退出 → 用 || true
    # 兜底, 否则 set -e 会中断脚本。
    for mustpkg in glibc-devel glibc-headers binutils gcc-toolset-10-gcc gcc-toolset-10-gcc-c++ gcc-toolset-10-libstdc++-devel gcc-toolset-10-libgcc; do
        f=$(ls "$RPMDIR"/${mustpkg}-*.rpm 2>/dev/null | head -1) || true
        [ -n "$f" ] && rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    done
    echo "  安装完成; gcc 版本: $(gcc --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo MISSING)"

    # 20.03 + 22.03 的最小镜像缺 ld 符号链接: binutils 装了 ld.bfd 但
    # /usr/bin/ld → /etc/alternatives/ld 的 alternatives 链未建(--nodeps 跳了
    # %post 脚本依赖的 chkconfig/alternatives)。手动建直链, 让 collect2 找到 ld。
    if [ ! -e /usr/bin/ld ] && [ -e /usr/bin/ld.bfd ]; then
        ln -sf /usr/bin/ld.bfd /usr/bin/ld
        echo "  建 /usr/bin/ld → ld.bfd 符号链接"
    fi
fi

# 20.03: gcc-10 以 SCL gcc-toolset-10 形式安装(在 /opt/openEuler/gcc-toolset-10/root/)。
